name: The Museum of Dots
summary:
Get your ticket to the Museum of Dots and explore four unique exhibitions of modern art. These moving expressions are designed to elevate your emotions and curiosity.

Dots have been scattered throughout the museum, inviting you to take part in a grand hunt. Explore every exhibition, search carefully, and see if you can find them all.
